text: Program Description Entrance Exam and Admission For Undergraduates The applicants, whose documents are approved by the International Student Exchange Office of the International Education, are required to attend the entrance exam given by BIPT. Field Subjects of Exam Date of Exam Sciences, Engineering and Administration Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English (written test) Mid May Arts Basic Chinese, English (written test) and Chinese Writing and Listening. Additional Oral English Test for English majors. Those who are ready to apply for Chinese government scholarship are required to attend the exam given by the local Chinese embassy. (This program is unavailable at BIPT now.) Duration of Study and Certificate An academic year is divided into three semesters: autumn semester( from early September to the next mid January),spring semester (from mid February to late June) and summer (from July to August).In summer semester students have field practice and short-term language training courses. For undergraduates the duration of study is 4 years. Students will be awarded a diploma of graduation and granted a bachelor’s degree, provided that they have completed the specified courses of study and passed all the examinations and the oral defence of dissertation. Requirements for Chinese Level Generally students are required to pass HSK 6 before studying at BIPT except for the following: Chinese language students do not have to pass HSK. After the test for their Chinese level given by BIPT, they will start at the appropriate level. For some programs taught in English, students do not have to pass HSK. With application visiting students do not have to meet the requirements for Chinese level or pass HSK. Instead, they are required to have a good knowledge of English.
